# 17 — Player-ready: built-in PokeMMO data and region maps (no imports), `develop`, v0.1.0

**Date:** 2026-11-23 · **Fixes:** `c562c0e` (which made maps depend on the player's own ROMs) · main untouched, no release.

## Requirement
Players never provide ROMs, PokeMMO dumps or route mappings. A brand-new installation must show all five regions
with clickable routes and their PokeMMO encounters, offline. Synergy is the reference for which maps exist and how
they behave (region tabs, labelled clickable areas, encounter panel); Serebii for the information structure
(per encounter method, Pokémon / levels / season / time of day). Nothing was copied from either site.

## What ships now
| Piece | Location | Content |
|---|---|---|
| PokeMMO reference data | `companion/data/reference/` (1.2 MB, gzip) | 649 species (stats, abilities, learnsets, evolutions), 559 moves, 2,090 item records (names/categories/uses — no description texts, no icons), 629 locations / 33,405 encounter rows. Built by `tools/build_reference.py` from the maintainer's own PokeMMO client dump dated **2026-11-16**. |
| In-game region maps | `companion/data/maps/game/*.png` | Kanto + Sevii 1–3, 4–5, 6–7 (FireRed BPRE rev 1), Johto (HeartGold/SoulSilver, Johto part of the Pokégear map), Hoenn (Emerald BPEE), Sinnoh (Platinum CPUE bottom-screen map; its stored palette is a darkened copy, shipped brightened ×2 for readability). **Shipped by owner decision** — see Rights. |
| Original Companion maps | `companion/data/maps/*.svg` | All five regions + Sevii, drawn for this project from hand-made layouts (`tools/mapgen/regions.py`). Unova uses this map (Unova's in-game Town Map was not located in the Black ROM). Selectable for every region with the *In-game map / Companion map* chip. |
| Click geometry | `companion/data/maps/geometry.json` | Towns (tiles), routes (lines), caves/landmarks/areas (pins) for both map styles, each linked to stable location ids of the bundled data. Generated by `tools/mapgen/build_maps.py`; the build fails on any unknown location. |

A personal PokeMMO client import (Settings › Data › *Optional, advanced*) still works and takes precedence (adds
client icons/sprites); a corrupt personal copy falls back to the built-in data. The ROM extraction service from
`c562c0e` remains only as a developer tool (`/api/maps…`); nothing in the player UI uses or offers it.

| Kanto (+ Sevii) | 124 | 124 | 124 | 79 | 7,520 / 7,520 |
| Johto | 104 | 104 | 104 | 55 | 6,006 / 6,006 |

| Sinnoh | 159 | 159 | 159 | 74 | 7,438 / 7,438 |
| Unova | 115 | — (no in-game art) | 115 | 55 | 6,902 / 6,902 |

Floors and sections stay separate (e.g. Mt. Moon → 1F / B1F / B2F tabs; Route 204/205/210/211/212 North/South
are separate areas). Towns without wild Pokémon say so instead of inventing encounters. "Honey Tree" is listed
as "not one place on the map". Area placement on the in-game images was read off a tile grid; a few split
boundaries are approximate (Sinnoh Route 220/221 on the bottom-screen map, Johto Routes 47/48, some Sevii pins).

## Player-facing changes
- Home *Get started*: "PokeMMO data and region maps are built in" — no install step, no dump banner.
- Settings › Data: built-in data status; personal import moved under *Optional, advanced*.
- Location explorer: no import button / unavailable state; region tabs; map with labels on by default; clicking a
  town, route or cave opens the encounter panel grouped per method (merged seasons, morning/day/night labels,
  horde chips, type badges); Pokémon search highlights the matching areas and counts per region.
- *My marks* (optional): your own marks are drawn on top in purple and stored separately; *Reset to shipped map
  data* removes them. Marks saved by `c562c0e` on ROM artwork are kept but hidden (their coordinates don't fit).
- Item library shows that description texts are not bundled. Sprites without a personal import fall back to
  numbered type-coloured discs (no Pokémon artwork is bundled).

## Rights (for the owner's decision)
- Bundled data: factual records derived from the PokeMMO client; game prose (item descriptions) and all sprites /
  icons excluded. Redistribution of data derived from the PokeMMO client is still the owner's call.
- **In-game map PNGs are Nintendo / Creatures / GAME FREAK artwork.** They are committed because the owner
  explicitly decided to ship them (2026-11-23) and takes the legal decision; there is no licence from the rights
  holders. The original Companion maps are a drop-in replacement if they need to be removed: delete
  `companion/data/maps/game/`, remove `GAME_MAPS` in `tools/mapgen/build_maps.py`, rebuild.
- No ROM, dump archive, Synergy/Serebii image or recording is in the repository (checked by a test).

## Tests
`tests/test_bundled.py`, `tests/ui/test_ui_builtin_maps.py` (clean profile, browser network blocked: every
region click → encounters, cave floors, town without wild Pokémon, Sevii sub-map, Pokémon highlight + zoom
